note: BH-7235: the retention window of the worklist gates' per-head state in state/lead-review-enqueue/ on each box: the risk-pub-*, inbuild-wait-*, traced-*, alerted-*, selfcheck-* and review-tier-* markers, silence/note-* and silence/scanned-*, and the rows of risk.tsv and requested.tsv (gates 50 and 95 prune delta.tsv, modes.tsv and failed-retry.tsv themselves). Once in 24 h a box deletes what is older (lg_tick_state_sweep in bin/lib/lead-gates.d/99-state-sweep.sh); the first run on a box only counts (dry run). 7 is the window the enqueue pruned with, so the 7-day readers (bin/pipeline-health.sh self-check count, gate 60) see the same data. It protects each box's disk from one file per PR head forever. 0 = off: nothing is deleted.
